props.name: hotkey
props.comment:
The key that toggles the menu, such as `"mod+k"` (`mod` is Meta or Ctrl).
`false` turns the hotkey off. Default `"mod+k"`.

props.name: resources
props.comment: Resource names to list and search. Default: every resource with a list view.

props.name: searchFields
props.comment: The filter key the record search sends, per resource. Default `"q"`.

props.name: perResourceLimit
props.comment: Most record hits per resource. Default `5`.

props.name: recentsLimit
props.comment: Most pages kept under Recent. Default `10`.

props.name: actions
props.comment: Commands to list beside the built-in ones.

props.name: searchDebounceMs
props.comment: Pause after typing before records are searched. Default `250`.
